packages.title: Stremio Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Stremio Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Anime upscale: Anime only: the TV's Super Resolution and gradation tuned for drawn pictures on the way to 4K, then put back. Settings › Playback.
Every title in its own language: Films and series start in the language you choose whenever the file has it, anime in Japanese. Settings › Audio.
Smarter search: Your recent searches, an Arabic keyboard, and spelling slips forgiven.
Skip, on a timer: The skip button leaves by itself after five seconds, a line showing the time left.
Reduce motion: Quicker moves and stiller pages for a slower TV. Settings › Appearance.
